title: Blueberry Meringue Dessert (Light Version)
excerpt: Enjoy this classic Colombian merengón in a lighter version, combining crisp meringues, soft yogurt cream and delicious fresh blueberries.
imageAlt: Light blueberry meringue dessert with layers of baked meringue and soft Greek yogurt cream.
steps: Preheat the oven to 110°C (230°F) and line a baking tray with wax paper or a silicone mat.
Beat the egg whites to stiff peaks. Add the granulated sweetener little by little like a rain, without stopping the beating, until you get a firm, glossy meringue.
Gently add the cornstarch and lemon juice with a spatula using folding movements so you don’t lose the air.
Shape 4 meringue discs or nests on the tray with a spoon and bake for 60 minutes at very low heat. Turn off the oven and let them rest inside for 30 minutes without opening the door.
In a bowl, mix the Greek yogurt with the honey and vanilla until well combined.

In a small pot over low heat, cook half a cup of your Fresh Pick blueberries with a teaspoon of water for 3 minutes until they soften slightly. These high-mountain blueberries grown in Guasca add the ideal natural sweetness.
To assemble, place a meringue base, add a generous layer of yogurt cream, the warm fruit sauce and finish with the rest of the whole fresh blueberries on top.
tips: Assemble the meringue desserts right before serving so the moisture from the cream doesn’t soften the crisp meringue layer.
Keep the remaining Fresh Pick blueberries in the fridge unwashed and in their original packaging; wash them with cold water only right before enjoying them.
